result:
My verdict is **PASS** for the DG4 round-4 candidate (`sha256:5ff36f6e…`, 1469 files, source `ccc37c9`), with two new findings that I don't consider blocking. The candidate ID matched at the start and the end, on a full clone and on the working tree.

**New findings** (both owned by frontend-ux-engineer):

| ID | Severity | Mandatory | Requirement | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG4-143 | Medium | no | REQ-S13-003 | When a value basis has nothing due yet, its line in "Value gap by basis and currency" reads "Unknown" next to "Not applicable". |
| F-DG4-144 | Low | no | REQ-S13-002 | With more than 50 transformations in a business unit, the dashboard says to narrow by phase or status, but doing so never lifts the block. |

- **F-DG4-143:** the API sends that line correctly as not applicable. The web screen turns every missing gap ratio into "Unknown", so the screen mixes up "unknown" and "not applicable". It is never shown as 0 or green, and the overall Value status is right. Seen on T10 and the Executive Overview in English and Arabic, in four runs. No web test covers this case.
- **F-DG4-144:** the 50-transformation limit itself is documented and I don't count it as a defect. My real-stack probe chose phase "realize" and status "closed", which match nothing in the unit. The block stayed and no request was sent.

**Round-3 repairs:** they hold on the real stack in both languages.
- **F-DG4-126:** the Value status is Red for margin 70 validated beside 300 of unvalidated revenue uplift. Each basis and currency gets its own line, and an unknown line makes the status Unknown, never Green.
- **F-DG4-127:** the Portfolio value is on the profit-and-cash basis and labelled as such (70 on screen, never 370). Decimals are kept (SAR 35.25 from 50 % of 70.5), and a USD benefit is never added.
- **F-DG4-105:** I followed more than 30 value drill-down links. Each names its currency and returns exactly that currency's figure and records. The 400/422 refusals, the multi-currency case and the access refusals behave as specified.
- **F-DG4-125 and D-124:** KPI values read "12 %", "12 % of users" and "1.5" (never "150 %"), the gap reads "100 %", and an outcome created through the API appears in the T10 Outcomes area.
- **Re-baselined tests:** each KBE-R7 and KBE-R8 change still asserts its clause; one check is now stricter. No QA acceptance test changed.

**Checks run** (all PASS):
- **Static:** typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (652 operations), no-CDN, format and contrast.
- **Unit:** Node 22 and 24 in both locale settings: 2885/2885, plus 259 passed and 2 skips by design.
- **Integration:** two runs of 1975/1975, migrations 0001–0061 and the contract test included. All 47 p4-pending lists are empty. The `tests/qa` suites alone: 172/172.
- **REQ-DLV-036:** 85/85. A04 has 8+4 tests, A09 17, A10 16 and A11 12+11+17; the A04 and A08/A09 e2e specs pass in both projects.
- **Validators:** register, pipeline and historical DG3/DG2/DG1 all pass.
- **Trace:** all 137 requirements have evidence tests in this round's logs.
- **Live registry, live CI and Keycloak:** offline/config surface only, as assigned (not BLOCKED).

**What failed along the way:**
- **30 s timeouts** in the full runs, at a load average around 15: p2 "Define → G2", p4-adoption-bau test 6 and p4-benefits test 8. All passed when re-run alone.
- **p4-dashboards test 3 (Arabic)** failed in both full runs. By then the suite had created more than 50 transformations in one business unit, so the dashboard blocked the request the test waits for. That's how I found F-DG4-144. It passes alone.
- **p4-dashboards test 4b (Arabic)** failed once, in a solo C.UTF-8 run, because my own test data pushed the line it looks for onto page 2 of a table. It passed in a later solo run (14/14).
- **The C.UTF-8 full run was stopped** by my shell's 2-hour background limit at test 365 of 368. Its unfinished tail was re-run alone.
- **My own probes:** two early e2e tries and the first business-unit probe failed on my test bugs, not product defects. They are recorded in the run notes.

I wrote three test files outside the frozen candidate and touched no product code; the disposable clones are removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-4/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence and run notes are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-4/`, and my tests in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-4/`.
